question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

ACTIVE
solution:
The correct answer is "**Busy**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **ACTIVE**: engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits.
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Lazy: **characterized by lack of effort or activity.
 
• **Similar: **having a resemblance in appearance, character, or quantity, without being identical.
 
• **Quiet: **making little or no noise.
 
• **Busy: **(of a time or place) full of activity.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given sentence, "**busy**" is the synonym of "active".
 
 
• **Example**: *I am going to be very **busy **__with summer camp this month.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **ACTIVE**: शारीरिक रूप से ऊर्जावान गतिविधियों में संलग्न या संलग्न होने के लिए तैयार।
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Lazy: ** प्रयास या गतिविधि की कमी की विशेषता।
 
• **Similar: ** उपस्थिति, चरित्र या मात्रा में समानता के बिना, समान होना।
 
• **Quiet: ** कम या कोई शोर नहीं करना।
 
• **Busy: ** (किसी समय या स्थान का) गतिविधि से भरा हुआ।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given sentence, "**busy**" is the synonym of "active".
